title: Pipeline Synergy — Simulation + PartGeometry + CAMKernel
description: Transform CNCSimulationPipeline, PartGeometryPipeline, and CAMKernelOrchestrator from self-contained engines into proper orchestrators that delegate to production engines. Target quality scores: CNCSimulation 75→95, PartGeometry 80→95, CAMKernel 80→95.

units.title: Wire 7 advertised engines into CNCSimulationPipeline
units.description: Wire GCodeSafetyAnalyzerEngine, SweptVolumeEngine, ToolAssemblyModelEngine, CollisionDetectionEngine (via AABB), and MachineKinematicsEngine into CNCSimulationPipelineEngine as real delegated calls instead of inline stubs.
acceptance: All 5 engines are imported and called during simulation pipeline execution
Pipeline results include real engine outputs, not inline approximations
Fallback to inline (from constants.ts) if engine import fails

units.title: Replace inline force/thermal/wear with engine delegation
units.description: Replace inline force/thermal/wear calculations with calls to KienzleForceModelEngine, AdvancedWearPhysicsEngine, and ConstitutiveModelEngine (Johnson-Cook thermal). Wire collision checking using SweptVolume AABB data.
acceptance: Collision checking uses SweptVolume AABB data

units.title: CNCSimulation engine delegation tests
units.description: Add 15+ tests covering each engine delegation path in CNCSimulationPipelineEngine, including fallback behavior when engines are unavailable.
acceptance: 15+ tests pass covering all delegation paths
Fallback paths tested for each engine

units.title: Replace inline S/F with SpeedFeedOrchestrator delegation
units.description: Replace inline 6-material speed/feed calculations with SpeedFeedOrchestratorEngine.compute() call. Replace inline chip thinning with InstantaneousEngagementEngine. Preserve fallback chain.
acceptance: Fallback chain preserved for when engines are unavailable

units.title: PartGeometry delegation tests
units.description: Add 5+ tests verifying PartGeometryPipelineEngine correctly delegates to SpeedFeedOrchestrator and InstantaneousEngagementEngine, including fallback behavior.
acceptance: Delegation and fallback paths both covered

units.title: Replace inline Kienzle/Taylor with SFO and ChipMorphology delegation
units.description: Replace inline Kienzle/Taylor in CAMKernelOrchestratorEngine with SpeedFeedOrchestratorEngine.compute() call. Replace inline Merchant shear model with ChipMorphologyDiagnosticEngine.
acceptance: Merchant shear model delegates to ChipMorphologyDiagnosticEngine

units.title: CAMKernel delegation tests
units.description: Add 5+ tests verifying CAMKernelOrchestratorEngine correctly delegates to SpeedFeedOrchestrator and ChipMorphologyDiagnosticEngine.
acceptance: Both delegation and fallback paths covered
